name: How should I prepare my bathroom before finish carpentry begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my bathroom before finish carpentry begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the finish carpenter arrives, clear the bathroom of personal items, ensure all tile grouting has cured, and verify the main ventilation fan is functional. Have your selected vanity dimensions, mirror sizes, and hardware selections on hand so trim reveals can be measured precisely. Confirm your choice of paint or stain finish ahead of time, as pre-priming or back-priming trim boards before installation protects them from hidden wall moisture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the space, ensure tile and drywall work are fully cured, have your vanity and mirror specs ready, and decide on paint or stain preferences in advance.
